weeks.title: THE JOURNEY BEGINS
weeks.intro: It was the first landing of my PRICE Protosem journey—a week that made me look inward, look around, and finally start looking at what I could create. From wonder to teamwork, from curiosity to consumer problems, and from ideas to possibilities, Week 0 gave me the first glimpse of what this journey could become.
